rules.sentence: Flecainide was found to be superior to digoxin and sotalol in the termination of fetal tachycardia, especially supraventricular tachycardia.
Flecainide was found to be superior to digoxin and sotalol in the termination of fetal tachycardia, especially supraventricular tachycardia.
Flecainide suppresses 76% of exercise-induced ventricular arrhythmias in 33 genotype-positive patients.
It is also efficacious in suppressing ventricular tachyarrhythmias in genotype-negative patients.
